description: Phone alert when the Bureau issues a new warning for the district (sheep graziers skipped). Major warnings any time and time-sensitive; minor ones 7 am to 10 pm. Opens the Weather dashboard.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] and trigger.to_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] }}

variables.new: {% set old = (trigger.from_state.attributes.warnings or []) | map(attribute='id') | list %}{% set skip = ['sheep_graziers_warning'] %}{% set ns = namespace(out=[]) %}{% for w in trigger.to_state.attributes.warnings or [] %}{% if w.id not in old and w.type not in skip and (w.warning_group_type == 'major' or 7 <= now().hour < 22) %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [w] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.out }}

data.title: {{ new[0].short_title }}{{ ' and %d more' % (new | count - 1) if new | count > 1 else '' }}
data.message: {{ new | map(attribute='title') | join('. ') }}. Tap for the forecast.

push.interruption-level: {{ 'time-sensitive' if new | selectattr('warning_group_type', 'eq', 'major') | list | count else 'active' }}
